blocks.text: Cell signalling tab shuru hoti hai jab signal molecule (ligand) target cell ki membrane par lage receptor se jur jata hai. Yeh receptors aam taur par cell membrane mein jure proteins hote hain, lekin cell ke andar bhi ho sakte hain. Har receptor sirf ek khaas ligand ke liye hota hai, jaise taala sirf apni chaabi se khulta hai.

Jab receptor ligand se jurta hai to us ki shakal badal jati hai (conformational change). Is se cell ke andar ka signalling pathway (raasta) chalu (activate) ho jata hai. Is mein aksar kai molecules ek ke baad ek asar dalte aur badalte hain; is silsile ko signalling cascade kehte hain, aur yeh signal ko bara (amplify) kar deta hai. Chhote molecules jaise cAMP (cyclic AMP), calcium ions aur inositol triphosphate (IP₃) second messengers (doosre paigham-rasan) ka kaam karte hain: yeh signal ko receptor se cell ke andar target molecules tak pohanchate hain.

Signal transduction pathway aksar gene expression badal deta hai, yani kuch khaas genes on ya off ho jate hain. Is se cell mein kai responses ho sakte hain, jaise cell ka barhna (growth), division, differentiation (khaas kaam ka cell banna) ya apoptosis (programmed cell death, yani tay-shuda tareeqe se cell ki maut). Signalling se cell ka metabolism, enzymes ki activity, ya ion channels ka khulna aur band hona bhi badal sakta hai.

blocks.alt: Extracellular space mein cell membrane wala cell. 1 Signal reception: signal molecule (ligand) membrane ke receptor se jurta hai. 2 Signal transduction: intracellular pathway ke relay molecules signal aage pohanchate hain. 3 Cellular response: signal cytoplasm mein jawab (response) paida karta hai.
